ChurchRegistry.title: ChurchRegistry
ChurchRegistry.description: Singleton document in church_config/registry that locks the primary owner (First Manager) of the church to prevent duplicate church accounts.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the primary first manager who registered the church.

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the primary manager.

ownerName.description: Full name of the primary manager.

churchName.description: Name of the church configured by the primary manager.

ChurchManager.title: ChurchManager
ChurchManager.description: Manager account document in church_managers/{uid} tracking approval status by the primary church owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

role.description: Role in the church management team.

status.description: Approval status controlled by the primary owner.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the account requested access.

ChurchPublicData.title: ChurchPublicData
ChurchPublicData.description: Public church data document in church_data/{docId} readable by all congregation members and writable only by approved church managers.

docType.description: Identifier of the church module data.

payload.description: Structured module data map for the church.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the approved manager who saved this update.

/church_config/{configId}.description: Stores the singleton 'registry' document locking the first manager of the church.

/church_managers/{managerUid}.description: Stores manager accounts and their approval status ('approved', 'pending', 'revoked').
